value.rationale: This solves the complete natural two-monomial commutator spectrum on the coefficient Hardy Dirichlet space, determining all singular sequences of all powers and exact superfactorial norm decay. It supplies the structural example of a quasinilpotent compact commutator whose every nonzero power lies outside every finite Schatten ideal, and establishes inverse recovery of unordered symbols from only the largest two singular values. These are motivated operator invariants, not arbitrary finite slices or mere computations.
